evidence.dom: 支配シェア=50(競争<40%)。**原本にシェア%開示なし**。市場構造の記述で確定: 10-K Item 1『COMPETITION』——『The North America MSW services industry is highly competitive and requires substantial labor and capital resources. Our competition includes: three publicly-held solid waste companies—Waste Management, Inc., Republic Services, Inc. and GFL Environmental, Inc.; several regional, publicly held and privately owned companies; and several thousand small, local, privately owned companies, including independent waste brokers, some of which we believe have accumulated substantial goodwill in their markets. ... We also compete with operators of alternative disposal facilities, including incinerators, and with counties, municipalities and solid waste districts that maintain their own waste collection and disposal operations.』Item 1A——『Our industry is highly competitive and requires substantial labor and capital resources. Some of the markets in which we compete or will seek to compete are served by one or more large, national companies, as well as by regional and local companies of varying sizes and resources.』E&Pも『Competition for E&P waste in the U.S. and Canada comes primarily from smaller regional companies that utilize a variety of disposal methods and generally serve specific geographic markets.』と分散。→ 上場大手3社＋地域数社＋**several thousand small, local, privately owned companies**＋自治体という分散構造を会社自身が述べており、自社シェア≥40%は定義上ありえない → v9.9.41規約3により空欄にせず50。※『Waste Connections, Inc. is the third largest solid waste services company in North America』『We are a leading provider of waste services in most of our markets』は**順位の自称でシェアの証拠にならない**(規約4)。上位3社合計シェアの数値は原本になく、むしろ『several thousand small... companies』＋自治体の明記が上位3社≥80%(寡占70)を否定する。なお exclusive franchise / municipal contract / G Certificate による**局所的な排他供給権**は保有するが、それは契約テリトリー単位の排他性であって市場全体のシェアではない(かつ『Exclusive franchises and municipal contracts may be subject to periodic competitive bidding』『we have approximately 454 contracts, representing approximately 4.0% of our annual revenues, which are set for expiration or automatic renewal on or before December 31, 2026』と再入札に晒される)。domではなく irr/dur で評価すべき性質。【同業突合】RSG 10-Kの競争記述(『a few other large, national publicly-owned companies, several regional publicly- and privately-owned companies and thousands of small privately-owned companies』)と同型であり、WCN/RSG の刻みは共に50で一致。出典: SEC 10-K FY2025(2025-12-31期) CIK0001318220 acc 0001104659-26-013700, Item 1 Business - COMPETITION / Item 1A Risk Factors. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318220/000110465926013700/wcn-20251231x10k.htm 【v9.9.41規約3の結論】原本は『several thousand small, local, privately owned companies, including independent waste brokers』『counties, municipalities and solid waste districts that maintain their own waste collection and disposal operations』と述べ、同一の役務を多数の事業者が供給する断片化した(fragmented)構造であることを自ら記している＝実質すべての供給は他社にも開かれている。よって自社が40%以上を占めることは定義上ありえず、残余の刻み50で確定する。

contracts through competitive bidding, early termination or governmental action」）——年間で入れ替わりうるのは売上の4.0%のみ＝96%は翌年動かないことの実数　《反証（同じ原本に同居する）》『These exclusive arrangements are awarded, at least initially, agreements and generally require competitive bidding at the end of the contract term.』 ／ 『Price increases may also result in customer churn as we may lose volumes which we are unable to replace at equivalent levels, including from either losing customers to lower-priced competitors or new competitors entering our markets as we raise prices.』 ／ 『The standard customer service agreements generally and most of our existing municipal contracts give us the **exclusive right** to provide specified waste services in the specified territory **during the contract term**』＋『an **exclusive period of seven years or longer**』＋G Certificateの『**exclusive and perpetual right**』。抽象語ではなく契約年数と排他性という粒度で名指しできる。検問3: 向きは正しい——当社が取得する認証の話ではなく（barrier **0件**・switch **0件**でONTO型の混入も無い）、'certif' 26件の中心は当社が保有する**排他営業権**(governmental certificates)。願望形でも新規参入障壁でもない。検問4/5 は下記。★実数で裏を取った: 『**weighted average remaining contract life of approximately five years**』——しかも**永久契約のG
